statement.text: Given a closed, 4-dimensional PSC manifold M, is there a (possibly disconnected) 4-dimensional orbifold $M^{1}$ with isolated singularities such that the following hold. (I) The orbifold M1 also admits a metric of positive scalar curvature. (II) All components of $M^{1}$ have finite orbifold-fundamental group. (III) M can be obtained from $M^{1}$ by a series of 0 and 1 surgeries. Here we also allow 0-surgeries between two orbifold points of the same type, which amounts to a removal of two subsets of the for $m D^{4}/\Gamma$ and an addition of a copy of $S^{3}/\Gamma \times$ [0,1].
